rules.name: Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects NTLM pass-the-hash attacks where an adversary uses a password hash instead of plaintext password
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%pass%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%hash%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Pass-the-Ticket (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos ticket reuse across systems indicating pass-the-ticket attacks
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%pass%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%ticket%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: RDP Anomalous Connection
rules.description: Detects anomalous RDP connections including unusual source IPs, off-hours access, or lateral movement patterns
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_003", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "dstport" IN (3389) AND "value" > 0

rules.name: SSH Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects SSH connections from compromised hosts to internal systems indicating lateral movement
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_004", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "dstport" IN (22) AND "value" > 0

rules.name: WMI/PSExec Remote Execution
rules.description: Detects remote execution via WMI, PSExec, or similar tools indicating lateral movement
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_005", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: SMB Lateral Movement via Admin Shares
rules.description: Detects lateral movement through SMB admin shares (C$, ADMIN$) for remote execution
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_006", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "dstport" IN (445, 139) AND "value" > 0

rules.name: DCOM Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects DCOM-based lateral movement through distributed COM object activation
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_007", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "srcaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "dstaddr" NOT LIKE '10.%' AND "value" > 0

rules.name: WinRM Remote Shell Access
rules.description: Detects Windows Remote Management shell access for lateral movement and remote execution
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_008", "action" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'VcnFlowLogs' AND "action" = 'REJECT' AND "dstport" IN (5985, 5986) AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Golden Ticket Attack (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos Golden Ticket attacks where forged TGTs grant persistent domain access
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_009", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%golden%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%ticket%') AND "value" > 0

rules.name: Silver Ticket Attack (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos Silver Ticket attacks using forged service tickets for targeted service access
rules.query: SELECT "siem_general_lm_010", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%silver%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%ticket%') AND "value" > 0
